scope: Exploratory development-only localization repair and mandatory attribute readout; no final-test access.
selection: Fixed final update for all variants; intermediate development metrics are diagnostics, not selection. No calibration or fusion with native classifier.
semantic_resource: Official CUB continuous class attribute profiles for candidate classes; extra benchmark side information, not equivalent to class-name-only CLIP. No profiles are recomputed from evaluation images.
inference: Images plus fixed model/attribute/class-profile assets. True image labels, attributes and part coordinates are never prediction inputs.
method_label: Part-supervised pooling plus DAZLE-inspired normalized attribute compatibility. Not a full DAZLE or TransZero reproduction.
